title: Guns and Robots: 143.6K accounts breached
summary: In approximately April 2016, the gaming website Guns and Robots suffered a data breach resulting in the exposure of 143k unique records. title: Autocentrum.pl: 143.7K accounts breached
summary: In February 2018, data belonging to the Polish motoring website autocentrum.pl was found online. The data contained 144k email addresses and plain text passwords.
